text:
alex: Evening handoff — wrapping up the 3.2 canary. No active incidents but two things to watch: 1) small tail-latency spike in EU canary earlier (~13:15 UTC) tied to KV evictions; 2) prod Redis patch scheduled tonight at 00:30 UTC. Action items below.

sam: @alex thanks — any immediate mitigations if evictions recur?

alex: If evictions recur, scale the redis cache pod +1 and flip the prefetch flag: `prefetch.enable=false`. I also bumped the mempolicy to volatile-lru on the canary cluster as a temp guard.

lee: Heads-up: infra maintenance for Redis OS patches at 00:30 UTC. Rolling patch, ~10m drain per node. Expect brief RTOs for cached requests — fallbacks to cold-starts possible. ops-bot will post 30m prior.

taylor: I’m on for 07:00–11:00 UTC tomorrow. @sam can you handover to me if anything's still open?

sam: Yep — will send a short DM before I log off. I’ll watch through midnight and escalate if error rate > 0.5% or p95 > 600ms. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: Reminder: Maintenance window starting 00:30 UTC — redis nodes infra-redis-01..04. Playbook: https://tickets/infra/REDIS-2024 (react: :bell:)

alex: Open PRs needing review: PR #3429 (prefetch tunables) — blocking canary; PR #3431 (redis bump) — final QA needed. Links: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3429 https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3431

alex: Action items:
- alex: continue canary until 00:00 UTC, collect p95/p99 and errors.
- sam: watch error rate and scale redis if evictions > 5/hr.
- taylor: pick up morning watch and verify canary metrics + storage health.
- lee: confirm infra patch preflight complete by 23:30 UTC.

alex: Quick checks: 
```
kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=redis
redis-cli -h <pod-ip> INFO memory
curl -s https://metrics.redwood.ai/canary | jq '.p95, .errors'
```

sam: acked, will DM if anything unusual. :eyes: 

lee: I’ll post a preflight at 23:20 UTC. If anyone sees high eviction counts before then, ping me directly.

taylor: Thanks all — I’ll pick up from Sam in the AM and keep an eye on the rollback thresholds.
